name: Primeval Brutality
body:
The brutal nature of your primitive attacks hit with supernatural accuracy.

Prerequisite: Mahrog, base attack bonus +5, Str 15.

Benefit: You gain a +2 competence bonus to damage rolls made while using improvised weapons. If you have the Club and Spear feat, you may also apply this bonus to weapons affected by that feat.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
